description: Explore the stunning underwater world of Kealakekua Bay, located on the Big Island and home to the historic Captain Cook monument. Our top-rated Kona snorkel tours offer a remarkable snorkeling experience along Hawaii's captivating coastline. Suitable for snorkelers of all skill levels, this tour provides high-quality equipment and experienced guides who share insights into the local marine life and history. Dive into the crystal-clear waters for some of the best snorkeling on the Big Island. On your return, enjoy the breathtaking coastal cliffs and explore mysterious sea caves, making your snorkeling trip in Kona truly unforgettable.

what_is_not_included_items.value: Personal swimwear - come with your swimsuit on and ready to snorkel

itinerary:
Our adventure at Honokohau Marina where we gear up to snorkel the waters off the Kona Coast. We head to the pristine marine sanctuary of Kealakekua Bay, known as one of the best snorkeling spots in the world and home to the famous Captain Cook Monument.

As we cruise along the stunning Kona coastline, we'll keep an eye out for Hawaiian spinner dolphins in their natural habitat, retreating to secluded coves after a night of hunting. Our journey into the open sea might even reward us with sightings of bottlenose dolphins, pilot whales, and spotted dolphins. And who knows? We might even spot a whale shark! During the winter months, we often see Humpback whales and their calves, which might treat us to some spectacular spouting and breaching.

When we reach Kealakekua Bay, you’ll have the chance to snorkel in clear, fish-filled waters, view vibrant coral reefs, and explore the marine life around the easily accessible Captain Cook Monument. We’ll provide snacks and drinks while sharing the intriguing stories of Captain Cook’s adventures. You’ll have plenty of time to enjoy the water and the underwater sights.

On our way back, we’ll take in the dramatic cliffs and explore ancient coastal sea caves formed by lava flows, all while learning about Hawaiian history and myths. Join us for this memorable day of exploration and fun on our Captain Cook snorkeling tour.

Check in and briefing: 15 - 20 minutes
Travel time: one hour or so with history stops on the way
Snorkel time: one hour to one hour 15 minutes
Return travel time:  one hour or more looking at seacaves & lavatubes or whales or dolphins
check_in_details:
- We run rain or shine (unless it affects safety)
- Minimum of six guests for charter to run. 

*While it typically isn't an issue we do have slower periods of the year it may occur.  If we do not reach our minimum, you'll be offered the option to rebook for a different day. If you are unable to join us on another day, you will have the option for a full refund.  You also have the option to purchase the additional seats to make the minimum, so the tour will run - that also means a private trip for you!*
what_to_bring:
- Swimsuit (please arrive in it)
- Sunglasses
- Hat
- Sun-protective cover-up
- Reef-safe non-aerosol sunscreen (toxic sunscreen is illegal in the bay)
- Towel

🚨Full face masks are not permitted on any of our trips due to safety concerns.
special_requirements: Minimum age is three years old, and anyone under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
restrictions:
- For safety, basic swimming skills are required to enter the water
Non-swimmers can enjoy the dramatic and spectacular Kona coastline while relaxing in the sun
- Expectant mothers or those with regular back or neck issues are not permitted on this tour due to the adventurous nature of our retired Navy SEAL boat
- We do not recommend our vessel for those 75 and older due to the adventurous nature of our boat
- You must be in good physical and mental health
- For safety, you must be able to converse in English
- We DO NOT RECOMMEND booking this snorkel trip (increased exertion) for at least two days after getting off the plane due to the risk of development of ROPE (Rapid Onset Pulmonary Edema)
disclaimers: Please note that if you are on the cruise ship and the cruise ship cancels, our standard cancellation policy applies, and a refund will not be available.
